analysis.rationale: Standalone net profit surged 77% YoY to ₹7,015.94 lakh and revenue grew 25% YoY to ₹33,511.25 lakh, indicating strong operational performance. Consolidated results also showed robust growth, supporting a positive outlook.
analysis.summary: Bajaj Consumer Care reported standalone Q1 FY27 net profit of ₹7,015.94 lakh (up 77% YoY) and consolidated net profit of ₹7,074.51 lakh (up 85% YoY), with revenue from operations rising 25% YoY on standalone and 25% YoY on consolidated basis.
